name: Enclosure generator
description: Designs a 3D-printable case for electronics: a box and lid with screws or snaps, PCB standoffs, port cutouts, vents and text, saved as a model or kept as a project to come back to.
author: Thingport contributors

screenshots.caption: A Raspberry Pi 4 case: the board's standoffs from its preset, labelled ports on two walls, honeycomb vents and text in the lid, which is lifted to show inside.
A sensor box in the dark theme: snap latches with an opening groove, mounting flanges, vents in the walls, a window for a screen and raised text on the lid.
Projects kept to open again, duplicate, download as JSON or delete.
